character: A skiers-only resort (no snowboards) beside Park City, separately ticketed from Park City Mountain, known for extensive grooming and a service-focused approach. Its original terrain spreads from the Snow Park base up through Silver Lake to Empire Canyon, and it is in the middle of a multi-year expansion toward a new East Village base near Jordanelle Reservoir.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain is at the Snow Park base (the Wide West learning area) with more green runs around Silver Lake, and the resort runs its own ski school. Skiing only. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson products.
